class.name: ObfuscationKey
class.brief_description: Loaded identity handle. The private half is not serialized into [code]res://[/code].
class.description: Wraps the RSA key, HMAC secret, and publisher/project ids kept under [code]user://obfuscation/[/code]. Export plugins never pack this resource. [method has_private] is [code]false[/code] for verify-only public keys.

method.name: get_project_id
method.description: Project id stored with the identity.

method.name: get_publisher_id
method.description: Publisher id stored with the identity.

method.name: has_private
method.description: [code]true[/code] when the key includes the private half.
